item.title: Testing RSS Import from AshB4
item.author: fleurdeviefarmsllc@gmail.com (Ashley Broussard)
item.description: A short source post used to verify that DEV Community can read the AshB4 RSS feed without importing existing DEV articles.
item.content:encoded:
This is a short source post used to test RSS import from the AshB4 portfolio site.

The goal is to confirm that DEV Community can read https://ashb4.github.io/feed.xml, see a non-DEV canonical URL, and import the post without duplicating existing DEV articles.

If this import works, future original posts can be added to the same centralized post metadata file and published through the generated RSS feed.
